company.name: Metoro
company.description:
Metoro is an AI SRE for teams running on kubernetes.

Autonomous deployment verification, issue detection, root causing and remediation via AI. Operational in less than 1 minute. No code changes needed.

Metoro uses eBPF to gather telemetry data at the Kernel level, this means zero code changes are needed, just a single agent install.

Live demo at https://demo.us-east.metoro.io

productsAndServices.description: A platform providing observability for Kubernetes clusters, collecting logs, metrics, traces, and profiling data automatically without code changes.
productsAndServices.name: Metoro Kubernetes Observability Platform

productsAndServices.description: Automatically generates application performance monitoring data including traces and RED metrics for services without manual instrumentation.
productsAndServices.name: Automatic Application Performance Monitoring (APM)

productsAndServices.description: Centralized collection, storage, and analysis of logs from all containers with support for structured JSON parsing and advanced search capabilities.
productsAndServices.name: Logs Management and Analytics

productsAndServices.description: Collects and visualizes detailed metrics for pods, containers, and hosts, supporting Prometheus and OpenTelemetry integrations.
productsAndServices.name: Metrics Collection and Visualization

productsAndServices.description: Provides zero-instrumentation CPU profiling for containers using eBPF, showing CPU time down to the function level for multiple programming languages.
productsAndServices.name: Profiling Service

productsAndServices.description: Tracks and indexes all Kubernetes resource changes and events, maintaining a complete history and derived metrics for cluster state analysis.
productsAndServices.name: Kubernetes Resources and Events Monitoring
